notes.title: First Public Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345503/fc2499b381fcfcb3860677357353f84a668ba785.png[/img]

Hey I'm Pascal from OrangePixel and happy to show you the first - and very EARLY IN DEVELOPMENT - DEMO version of Space Grunts 3 !

[h2]Current Status[/h2]

The game is still at least 6-7 months away from a full release, and a LOT has to be added and perfected, but I wanted to have a demo out there for all the Turn Based Festival players and also everyone interested in seeing what I have planned and am working on for this game.

So grab yourself a copy, and take the current version for a spin. I will be pushing updates to the demo every now and then as progress is made until we get close to a release.

[h2]Follow along and Feedback[/h2]

You can follow the development on Space Grunts 3 in my weekly Youtube videos, or come hang out on my Discord channel and don't forget to Wishlist the game if it tickles you in the right way!

I'm VERY open to feedback and ideas for shaping this game into a worthy follow-up to the awesome original Space Grunts.

Later!!!
- Pascal / OrangePixel
